title: Continuation Composition Algebra
purpose: Define how continuation objects compose without treating composition as simple symbolic rewriting.

canonical_claims.statement: Continuations may compose when their endpoint conditions are compatible.
Composition is process composition, not symbolic concatenation.
Residue must propagate through composed continuation.
Composition may fail if admissibility is broken.
Successful composition produces a new continuation object.

formal_objects.name: Continuation Composition
formal_objects.definition: A lawful process composition of continuation objects that yields C(A,C) only when the shared endpoint matches and residue/admissibility are preserved.

formal_objects.meaning: ASCII chain notation for process composition of continuations.

laws.name: Endpoint Compatibility
laws.meaning: Composition is lawful only when the codomain of the first continuation matches the domain of the second.

laws.name: Process Composition Notation
laws.meaning: The ASCII chain denotes process composition, not symbolic concatenation or rewrite.

laws.name: Residue Propagation
laws.formal: r participates in composed continuation semantics
laws.meaning: Residue remains part of the composite continuation's admissibility and history.

laws.name: Admissibility Failure
laws.formal: Composition fails if admissibility is broken at the shared endpoint
laws.meaning: Shared-endpoint mismatch or admissibility failure rejects the composite continuation.

validation_requirements: Continuation composition is a process composition, not symbolic concatenation.
global_validate.py passes aside from existing unrelated warnings.
